title: Freya and the Terminal
author: Theo Villalobos
blurb: Beatrix Voss, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
